final: WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT link_to_member, total_amount, 1.0 * total_amount / SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS share FROM member_totals) SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS combined_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - AVG(share) OVER ()) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
